upaṭṭhāna.p: [Upa+ṭhā+yu] (na) CL=7 (1) (A) Appears. Appears or remains present. Stands near. Do not give up. (Mindfulness). that approaches, concentrates, and contemplates. (B) Takes care of and attends. (C) Arises. (D) Comes close and attends. Appears or remains present. (E) gather, come close, and attend.
